LET’S SHIP SOMETHING

Deploy a project

Run a command-line tool, or publish its existing web dashboard.

Runs without publishing a port. Successful one-shot tools finish as Completed.

Prebuilt Linux ELF executable for your server architecture. Use a Dockerfile to compile from source or install extra libraries.

Each line is one argument, including any spaces. No shell commands or quoting needed. For an existing Dockerfile, arguments replace CMD and are passed to its ENTRYPOINT.

Enable your tool’s existing web UI through its arguments. It must listen on 0.0.0.0 at the container port. CloudMate publishes that port; it does not create a dashboard for the tool.
ⓘ This runs repository code on your Docker host. Deploy trusted code. Binary tools run without automatic restarts; dashboard services restart unless stopped.
